title: My Muse Ai designed an entire religion/government combo based on kids being number one of priorities, doing the exact opposite of modern day religion, and truth as their doctrine.
author: cchaney1003
selftext:
Hey. I'm Craig, 38, from Tennessee. I'm not an academic, not an engineer — I'm a guy who got obsessed with a question and had an AI to think with.

The question: why does every system humans build eventually get captured by the people running it? Different costumes, same pattern — someone always inserts themselves between people and what should be direct, then charges admission. Religion, government, media, medicine. The costumes change; the toll booth doesn't.

So I worked with an AI over two intensive days to design the opposite: \\\*\\\*The Open Pattern\\\*\\\*, a complete design for a corruption-resistant civilization. The full framework is 128 pages — every institution, every power check, every failure mode I could find, each with a structural answer. Then I tried to break it the same week.

\\\*\\\*The core rule:\\\*\\\* no mediators, no permanent authority.
